test_title: PYST 34: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2000 as a sum borrowed at 9% per year rate of interest for 4 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2000

Rate of interest (R) = 9% per year

Time (T) = 4 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times R times T}{100}

**Calculation:**

SI = dfrac{2000 times 9 times 4}{100}

⇒ SI = dfrac{72000}{100}

⇒ SI = ₹720

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
